tasks.title: Chats keep working their board without help
tasks.description:
Every chat keeps working through its own board view without help.

Problem

  • A chat's loop dies silently when it expires or restarts.

  • Poteto's loop expired, and its Todo tickets sat for hours.

  • Nobody notices until Valentin looks at the board.

making sure agents give themselves a proper board drain loop

Fix

  • A vstack skill named board-drain-loop. Each chat runs it on itself.

  • It loops over the chat's own view until a finish check passes.

  • It records when the loop expires. Each round restarts it well before then.

  • Each round syncs the board and flags Todo tickets idle two hours.

  • valentin-mode checks the loop at every start.

Done when

  • A chat whose loop expired restarts it on its own.

  • The test transcript is on this ticket.

Risk

A loop could run too often and waste tokens. Undo: stop it with one command.

Decision

None.

Hypertask board: 2060, label: Board Drain Loop.
